> 前言一 引光与暗（第1页）
（注：本书引子有亿点点长，不喜勿喷）
一阵阴凉的风掠过，无情地将胡啸天手中的花吹散。他苦笑着，自言自语道：“呵呵，连一朵花都不肯让我留恋一下吗？”
这句话仿佛是对命运的嘲讽，也是他内心无奈的呐喊。那朵被吹散的花，如同他破碎的心，在风中凋零。
胡啸天抬头看向黑色天空，一座破碎的门在天空中倾斜着，仿佛随时都要倒下，大门敞开着，自那门中涌出许多规则乱流。
“胡啸天，本座最后问你一次，降还是死。”
天空深处，一双黑色巨眼猛的睁开，死死的盯着胡啸天。
“明知故问，有意思吗。”胡啸天抬头看着那双巨眼。
“好，本座倒要瞧瞧，你还能嚣张多久！”
巨眼猛地射出凶狠的光芒，宛如九幽地狱中的恶鬼，令人不寒而栗。随后，一只如同山岳般庞大的黑色巨手从那天边缓缓浮现，带着毁天灭地的气息，如同一颗坠落的星辰，向着胡啸天疾驰而去。
“奉陪到底。”胡啸天飞上天空，浑身武气剧烈翻涌。
一个巨大的拳头从胡啸天手中飞出，与黑色巨手猛的撞在一起。
两只手发生爆炸，余威让本就不牢固的天道彻底坠落。
胡啸天身后浮现一幅阴阳图，随后周围那黑色的死气逐渐被吸引涌入阴阳图内，化为一股精纯的灵气，进入胡啸天体内。
“胡啸天，本座吞噬过无数世界，然而你，却是最令我赞赏之人。你若愿归顺于我，我所吞噬的这偌大世界，将与你对半分享，岂不善哉？”
黑色的巨眼消失，一个浑身流淌黑气的人形生物从这漫天死气中走出。
“要打就打，不打就滚。”胡啸天眼中怒火中烧，死死的盯着黑暗。
“胡啸天，你要想清楚，倘若不是你有阴阳霸体，你早就死在那场大战中，怎么可能还有机会在这里和我说这般狠话，你打不过我，这是事实，纵使你能净化我的死气，但你又能坚持多久。”黑暗看向胡啸天。
“那就试试。”胡啸天盯着黑暗，冲了上去。

近百年的鏖战，二人依然难分胜负。
“胡啸天，你已是风中残烛，还要继续吗？”黑暗以居高临下之姿看着胡啸天道。
“哼，黑暗，总会有一个人，将你彻底消灭。”胡啸天手扶世界边界，纵使气喘如牛，却仍死死地盯着黑暗。
“可惜，那个人不会是你，你也永远看不到那一天。”黑暗嘲笑道。
“也许吧。”胡啸天叹息道：“黑暗，你可知道，当天道崩塌之时，这个世界便已不复存在。”胡啸天突然没来由地说了一句。
黑暗茫然不解，默默地看着胡啸天。
“天规有言，本世界之人，无法击破天界，可如今天道已逝。”胡啸天喃喃自语。
“你疯了不成，胡言乱语些什么！”黑暗怒斥道。
“我疯了吗？也许吧，当这片天地只剩我一个人的那一刻，我可能就疯了。”胡啸天自我解嘲道。
“胡啸天，即便你死了，我也能夺舍你的身躯，届时你的结局同样凄惨，我最后劝你一次，投降。”黑暗不耐烦地说道。
“黑暗，打败你的人的确不是我，但我一定能见证那一天的到来。”胡啸天凝视着黑暗，随后转身使出全力，猛然一拳击打在天界之上。
天空一角化为碎片落在大地之上，缺口中，露出一片虚空。
“不！”黑暗瞬间明白了他想干什么，大喊着扑向胡啸天。
胡啸天没有半分犹豫，一步踏入虚空，向外界极速飞去。
“胡，啸，天！”黑暗在缺口中怒喊着，声音响彻整个虚空。
远方，胡啸天回望着家乡，眼角留下两行清泪。

> Preface 1: Leading Light and Darkness (Page 1)
(Note: The introduction to this book is hundreds of millions of points long, so don’t use it if you don’t like it)
A gust of cool wind passed by, ruthlessly blowing away the flowers in Hu Xiaotian's hands. He smiled bitterly and said to himself: "Haha, you won't even let me miss a flower?"
This sentence seemed to be a mockery of fate, and also a helpless cry from his heart. The blown flower was like his broken heart, withering in the wind.
Hu Xiaotian looked up at the black sky. A broken door was leaning in the sky, as if it was about to fall down at any time. The door was open, and many regular turbulent flows poured out from the door.
"Hu Xiaotian, I ask you for the last time, surrender or die."
Deep in the sky, a pair of huge black eyes suddenly opened, staring at Hu Xiaotian.
"Is it interesting to ask knowingly?" Hu Xiaotian looked up at those giant eyes.
"Okay, I want to see how long you can be arrogant!"
The giant eye suddenly shot out a fierce light, like an evil ghost in the Nine Nether Hell, which made people shudder. Then, a giant black hand as huge as a mountain slowly emerged from the horizon, carrying a heaven-destroying aura, like a falling star, and rushed towards Hu Xiaotian.
"Stay with me to the end." Hu Xiaotian flew into the sky, his martial energy surged violently.
A huge fist flew out of Hu Xiaotian's hand and collided with the giant black hand.
The two hands exploded, and the remaining power caused the already fragile Tiandao to fall completely.
A Yin-Yang diagram appeared behind Hu Xiaotian, and then the surrounding black death energy was gradually attracted and poured into the Yin-Yang diagram, turning into a stream of pure spiritual energy and entering Hu Xiaotian's body.
"Hu Xiaotian, I have devoured countless worlds, but you are the person I admire the most. If you are willing to submit to me, I will share this huge world that I have devoured with you in half. Wouldn't it be good?"
The giant black eye disappeared, and a humanoid creature with black energy flowing all over its body walked out of the death aura.
"If you want to fight, then fight. If you don't want to fight, then get out." Hu Xiaotian's eyes were filled with anger as he stared into the darkness.
"Hu Xiaotian, you have to think clearly. If it weren't for your yin-yang hegemony, you would have died in that battle. How could you still have the opportunity to say such cruel words to me here? You can't beat me. This is a fact. Even if you can purify my death energy, how long can you hold on." Darkness looked at Hu Xiaotian.
"Then give it a try." Hu Xiaotian stared at the darkness and rushed forward.
After nearly a hundred years of fierce fighting, it is still difficult to tell the winner between the two.
"Hu Xiaotian, you are already a candle in the wind, do you want to continue?" Darkness looked at Hu Xiaotian in a condescending manner.
"Huh, darkness, there will always be someone who will completely wipe you out." Hu Xiaotian held the border of the world with his hand, even though he was panting like an ox, he still stared at the darkness.
"Unfortunately, that person won't be you, and you will never see that day." Darkness mocked.
"Maybe." Hu Xiaotian sighed: "Darkness, do you know that when the heaven collapses, this world will no longer exist." Hu Xiaotian suddenly said something for no reason.
Darkness was confused and looked at Hu Xiaotian silently.
"The rules of heaven say that people in this world cannot break through the heaven, but now the heaven is gone." Hu Xiaotian murmured to himself.
"Are you crazy? What nonsense are you talking about!" Darkness yelled angrily.
"Am I crazy? Maybe, when I am the only one left in this world, I may go crazy." Hu Xiaotian laughed at himself.
"Hu Xiaotian, even if you die, I can still take your body, and your ending will be equally miserable. I advise you one last time to surrender." Darkness said impatiently.
"Darkness, it is true that I am not the one who defeats you, but I will definitely be able to witness the arrival of that day." Hu Xiaotian stared at the darkness, then turned around and used all his strength to suddenlyA punch struck the heaven.
A corner of the sky turned into fragments and fell on the earth, revealing a void in the gap.
"No!" Darkness instantly understood what he wanted to do, shouted and rushed towards Hu Xiaotian.
Without any hesitation, Hu Xiaotian stepped into the void and flew towards the outside world at high speed.
"Hu, Xiao, Tian!" The darkness shouted angrily in the gap, and the voice resounded throughout the void.
In the distance, Hu Xiaotian looked back at his hometown, with two lines of clear tears left in the corners of his eyes.
